q311488.placeNote: Born in the east of Mongolia; Wikidata says Dadal, other sources a monastery in what is now Dornod. The pin is the middle of Khentii Province.

cur-find-xujiayao.dateNote: Human fossils dug here in the Nihewan Basin, Shanxi, in 1976-1979, about 200,000-140,000 years old. In 2026 a team led by Qiaomei Fu (IVPP, Beijing) read ancient proteins from them and found a protein variant known only in Denisovans, so the Xujiayao people were Denisovans. The authors suggest other Chinese fossils, such as Dali, Jinniushan and Hualongdong, may be Denisovan too; that is not yet shown (Nature, October 2026).
